acceptance_note: Floors are accepted only when a supervisor-chosen strict ancestor of the candidate (run-quality-candidate.py --floors-anchor) holds an entry for the same corpus hash with review.status 'accepted-independent-review'. The candidate's own file cannot assert acceptance. To accept: after independent review of corpus labels, runner and floors, change review.status to 'accepted-independent-review', run `cd scripts && python3 -m quality_candidate.floors seal ../docs/quality/candidate-floors.json`, merge, and have CI pass the merged commit as the anchor.

review.label_review: Reviewed and accepted by Ronaldo on 2026-10-14 across all 50 synthetic memories and 49 queries (EN/PT)
review.justification: Floors equal the deterministic Q7 measurement (offline TF-IDF provider) rounded down to 3 decimals, and the relevance labels, category coverage (EN/PT, typos, negation, ambiguous entities, duplicates, daily/transcript filters, workspace isolation) and floors were independently reviewed and accepted by owner Ronaldo on 2026-10-14.
